programme.title: Aakhri Ghulam
programme.desc: Bheema, his father Dinu and generations of their family have been slaves of the wealthy Thakurs. One day, he challenges their authority and invites trouble for himself in the process.

programme.title: Kusthi
programme.desc: Jeeva runs away to the city to avoid an arranged marriage. Soon, he befriends Singam, a local goon, after which, they get involved in many mishaps together.

programme.title: Salta Diya
programme.desc: A rich man's wife and a thief's wife simultaneously give birth to twin sons, from which two of them get exchanged. Years later, an unexpected event leads them to swap places once again.

programme.title: Love Mocktail 2
programme.desc: With the semblance of leading a normal life, Adi struggles with the loss of his wife, Nidhi. However, Sihi, a charming young woman, enters as a glimmer of hope when she commits to helping Adi.

programme.title: Mast
programme.desc: Kittu is madly in love with Malika, an actress, and travels to her house in Mumbai from Pune after his father scolds him for his decreasing exam scores.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: 16 December
programme.desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers are assigned to intercept and arrest a group of Pakistani terrorists. The terrorists plot to detonate a nuclear bomb in New Delhi and the IRS must stop them.

programme.title: Demon
programme.desc: Vignesh Shivan has scary dreams that bother him a lot. However, the strange things in his dreams make him worry and affect his mind.

programme.title: Chalte Chalte
programme.desc: Geeta is admitted to a mental hospital after her lover passes away tragically. Later, she gains her senses, only to find him alive and in love with another woman.

programme.title: Humse Hai Zamana
programme.desc: Ravindra and Gowri, who belong to rival factions, are sworn enemies. After being imprisoned and learning that his brother was killed, Gowri goes after Ravindra's sister, Preeti, as revenge.

programme.title: Prithipal Singh...A Story
programme.desc: Disappointed with his Olympic bronze medal, Prithipal Singh quits hockey and joins a university. However, things get worse for him when he is accused of murdering a student.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Samay-when the time strikes
programme.desc: ACP Malvika Chauhan, a widowed mother, is assigned to investigate the murder of a businessman. However, she suspects it to be a serial killer as more murders take place in the city.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Ka
programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.title: Antim Nyay
programme.desc: Jay Singh encounters Seema while struggling to seek justice for his deceased father. As the couple attempts to live a happy life, unforeseen circumstances invite more troubles.

programme.title: Main Intequam Loonga
programme.desc: Kumar learns that his father, a national level boxing champion, was killed when he refused to lose a fight. He vows to annihilate his father's killers, unaware that he may face tragic consequences.

programme.title: Mithya
programme.desc: Albert Samson, a successful architect, and Alice are leading an unhappy married life because of Samson's ambitious and egoistic nature. Hilda Varghese enters Samson's life and changes it completely.

programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka
programme.desc: Sikander, an honest union worker, is harassed and sent to jail when he tries to stop the unscrupulous activities of his evil employer. After he gets released, he sets out to destroy him.

programme.title: Solid Hits

programme.desc: S2 E8 — SpinningThe Teletubbies travel by Tubby Car to the Hidey Hup, where they all spin around on the Tubby Spinny.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Andy and the Runaway AnkylosaurusAndy and Jen discover a meteorite crater on Dino Island, but when a grumpy Ankylosaurus charges through camp, they must work together to save it from falling into the crater.

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: S1 E4 — The SackThe Fantastics playfully sack Georgie. Jaz is appointed as the team's new coach, but finds it harder than she thought. Georgie tries her hand at other jobs with chaotic results.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Amazing MotorbikesMotorbike rider Grace shows off three amazing machines, all of which are different kinds of motorbikes! Grace rides a classic touring bike, then shows off futuristic self-balancing bikes before heading to an indoor motocross course to ride an electric dirt bike.

programme.title: Musical Storyland
programme.desc: S1 E4 — The Great RaceMany years ago, the Jade Emperor of China held a race across a great river to decide the order of the years of the zodiac. The emperor invited all the animals of the world, but only 12 chose to race.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: S4 E1 — Episode 1Ginger and the Peas reluctantly babysit a mischievous baby Bananaraptor that proves to be more than a handful.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: S5 E4 — Ghost ShipThe Octonauts follow a trail of deep-sea debris to its source: a derelict ship floating unmanned on the surface. But the ship seems to be haunted by ghostly voices, which a quick dip below the water line reveals to be hundreds of barnacles stuck to the ship. As the ship drifts into waters too cold for the barnacles, the Octonauts must find a way to tow it to warmer waters before it sinks or falls apart.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: S3 — High-Flying BadgerWhen a very sleepy Tommy Brock is hoisted up into the Squirrel Camp, Peter and friends must work out how to get the snoozing brute back down to earth before he wakes up!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S2 E16 — The Medicine BadgeDuggee's not very well. He's lost his voice. The squirrels want to make him feel better. Duggee tries to tell them that he needs some water, but the squirrels don't quite understand, so they ask all the other animals for advice. Does anyone have the answer?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S2 E17 — The Camping BadgeDuggee and the Squirrels are going camping. They need to find somewhere to pitch their tent, but it's not as easy as they thought it would be. They all work together and finally get settled. But Tag realises he can't sleep without his teddy, and Happy would like a glass of water. Suddenly Duggee is up and down and in and out of the tent getting everything the Squirrels need. In fact, Duggee works so hard that he's the first to fall asleep.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: S4 E12 — Miss Gerrard's BirthdayIt's Miss Gerrard's birthday, and the children plan a surprise party for her. Felicity and Coen are the chefs. They're in charge of baking and decorating a delicious birthday cake, with help from Mrs Bailey. Theo and Jasper are making a beautiful birthday crown for Miss Gerrard to wear, and have asked Mrs Hussain to help them. With everything ready, it's time for the surprise party!

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: S4 E26 — Fortune CookiesEvil Pea tricks Supertato and Broccoli with fake fortune cookies that tell them to go outside the supermarket. Thankfully, Carrot doesn't believe them and saves the day.

programme.title: Weasy Family
programme.desc: S1 E34 — Mission CalmThe Ducklings transfer Weasy's mind into the body of a snail - what could go wrong?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Pirate ParadeMojo and Bo fix Ted up as a pirate ship for the Pirate Parade, but swashbuckling Cap'n Dot hijacks him. Team Mojo must out-pirate Dot and sail the streets to stop her.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E18 — RainWhen a heavy summer rain thunders over the Heeler home, Bluey is determined to dam the water in the front yard, while Mum tries to stop her constantly tracking mud into the house.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E42 — Bin NightBluey, Bingo and Dad always take out the bins. Over a few weeks, Bingo tells Dad about a new kid at kindy who is mean to her and Mum offers some good advice.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: S1 E13 — Flame BlameWhen Gadabout and Pearl lose the cure for Madam Dragon's missing flame, Zog helps them work together to assist his former teacher.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: S2 — The Very Hot DayIt's a very hot day at Pup School, so Miss Collie lets the pups set up the paddling pool.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: S2 — Waffle's Club Camp FunIt's After School Club Camp, and everyone has a tent - including Waffle. But Waffle is far more interested in Mrs Hobbs's purple slippers, and the camp-out takes an unexpected turn.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: The Pirate WishRafi's wish sends the friends on a real pirate adventure at the swimming pool.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: S2 — Autumn: It's Time to See the PlanetsCaptain Chloe's adventures through space inspire JoJo and Gran Gran, who make a visit to the space centre to learn lots about planets at the planetarium. Then later, back at Gran Gran's house, they try to see if any planets are out.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: S2 E25 — The Forgotten TunnelGranny, Tiny and Small go on a trip that leads them to a forgotten tunnel. They are fascinated by the things they find there, and by the strange sounds they can hear.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: S1 E11 — SorryBaba learns that when you apologise, you need to truly mean it.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Igglepiggle's Blanket in Makka Pakka's DitchIgglepiggle has lost his blanket, and Upsy Daisy helps him look for it. The Gazebo shows them a picture of Makka Pakka, so they visit him and find the blanket in Makka Pakka's ditch, blocking Makka Pakka's way.

programme.title: Hushabye Lullabye
programme.desc: S1 E5 — SpringDillie Dallie goes puddle splashing as the clouds burst with raindrops! Umbrellas are whirling and twirling and Flutterbye Butterfly flutters by, as a rainbow grows in the sky.

programme.title: Cbeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: S2024 — Vernon Kay - You Can Do Anything (Hip and Hop)Vernon Kay encourages you to focus on your dreams in this Bedtime Story.

programme.title: Canals: The Making of a Nation
programme.desc: S1 E2 — GeologyLiz McIvor discovers how carving up the landscape in order to build canals helped further our understanding of the earth below.

programme.title: Pubs, Ponds, and Power: The Story of the Village
programme.desc: S1 — SouthThe village of Milton Abbas in Dorset perfectly captures the romantic notion of the idyllic English village, but as archaeologist Ben Robinson reveals, behind it lurks a history of one man's wealth and power. With help from local historians, Ben learns how the local landowner in the 18th century destroyed a nearby town, uprooting its residents, because it ruined the view from his house. The landscape was transformed, and a new village was built as part of his showpiece estate.

programme.title: A Timewatch Guide
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Roman BritainUsing 50 years of BBC History archive film, Dr Alice Roberts investigates how views and understanding of Roman Britain have changed over the decades. Along the way she investigates a diverse range of subjects from the Roman invasion, through Hadrian's Wall, the Vindolanda tablets and the eventual collapse of Roman rule.

programme.title: Slumdog Millionaire
programme.desc: A child from the Mumbai slums is accused of fraud after victory in India's 'Who Wants to be a Millionaire?'.

programme.title: A.R. Rahman
programme.desc: A. R. Rahman chats to Haroon Rashid about his 30+ year career producing music for some of India's most iconic films, international successes, AI and working with Hans Zimmer.

programme.title: The Lost Libraries of Timbuktu
programme.desc: Aminatta Forna tells the story of legendary Timbuktu and its long hidden legacy of hundreds of thousands of ancient manuscripts. With its university founded around the same time as Oxford, Timbuktu is proof that the reading and writing of books have long been as important to Africans as to Europeans.

programme.desc: S2 E9 — LeekLive from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Leek, who won't let anything, not even the chilly conditions backstage, stop him from singing his song 'Can't Hold Me Down'.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: S1 E33 — BooCoco shows Bing how to do fantastic big boos, and together they make Flop jump. When Bing tries out his new tricks on Charlie he finds out the power of boo has to be scaled down for babies.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: S2 E41 — Bottom BumpThe Teletubbies bottom bounce on The Tubby Bouncy before wiggling their bottoms to a special bottom bump song.

programme.title: Tee and Mo
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Action ApeMo calls Tee for bath time, but Tee wants one more game with his favourite toy Action Ape. Maybe bubbles will coax Tee into the bath.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: S1 E26 — Return of the Printing CrewBlack joins the Printing Crew. Learn how yellow, cyan, magenta and black work together in printing with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Bluey Minisodes
programme.desc: S2 E3 — BlocksAfter building an enormous tower of blocks, Bluey and Bingo ask Nana to keep the tower up. Nana and Bob try to live in their small unit without knocking the tower over.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: S2 E16 — MagnetsCoco is showing Bing how magnets work. While Coco builds a tower, Bing wants to find more magnetic things. In the garden he tests the ball, table and key, announcing which are magnetic. When Bing tries the watering can, he accidentally drops the magnet behind the flowerbed! Neither Bing nor Coco can reach it, so Flop shows them how to fish with magnets.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E35 — X Marks the SwopAn old map, mysterious clues and ancient secrets, Mojo and Bo are after the treasure of the Knights of Swoppiton! But Preston is after it too, so they need to get there first.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S3 E8 — The Big Day Out BadgeMeet Duggee, a big lovable dog who runs a club for pre-schoolers that inspires children to have fun, be energetic, and - most of all - to do things!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S3 E9 — The Tree BadgeDuggee helps the Squirrels learn about all the amazing things trees do for the creatures who live amongst them, and earn their tree badges in the process.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E19 — Pizza GirlsBluey and Bingo make mud pizzas and deliver them to the grown-ups, but their pedal car's wheel keeps falling off.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E43 — Muffin ConeWhen Muffin can't stop sucking her thumb, she has to wear a cone of shame. But the cone gets in her way and she can no longer play 'sandwich shop' with Bluey and Bingo.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: S3 E7 — Go Jetter Heroes: Polar ExplorersWhen Glitch and Kyan race to the South Pole, Glitch's loyal Grimbots steal the pole's marker to help Glitch win. But when Glitch orders them to return it, they find themselves lost and trapped in the ice - and the Go Jetters must spring into action to rescue them.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: S1 — The Tale of the Angry CatWhen Peter accidentally brings home Mr McGregor's cat rather than a cart of freshly-picked brussels sprouts, he has to find a way to lure the angry cat back into the garden while staying one step ahead of her claws.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: S1 E29 — The Seahorse TaleCaptain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. After a storm, the Octonauts have to reunite a seahorse with its missing mate - who is about to give birth to baby seahorses.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: S6 E9 — On My Way to Numberblock FairLearn how much fun counting can be with the Numberblocks - a fun-loving group of numbers who work together to solve problems big and small.

programme.title: Wonderblocks
programme.desc: S1 E15 — First Things FirstSing along with Go and Stop as they get ready for a picnic.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: S1 E15 — Give It Another Go DayLove Monster doesn't like the beach but tries to give it another go by looking for an aspect of it that he can enjoy.

programme.title: Justin's House
programme.desc: S1 E16 — Blocked PipesSomething is blocking the pipes, and they need to find out what it is. Robert and Justin find out that it is a furry Flitter. With Little Monster's help, they finally find a better place for the Flitter to stay in, but only after many soakings.

programme.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
programme.desc: An old man tells a journalist the story of his youth as a lobby boy at a hotel in Eastern Europe in the 1930s. He was taken under the wing of the establishment's dashing concierge, and is drawn into his misadventures as he becomes involved in a conflict over a valuable painting. Wes Anderson's comedy drama, starring Ralph Fiennes, Tony Revolori, F Murray Abraham and Jude Law.

programme.title: Veronica Guerin
programme.desc: Fact-based drama about crime reporter Veronica Guerin, who set out to expose Ireland's crime lords but ended up paying the ultimate price. The film opens with the journalist's assassination, then looks back to trace her attempts to establish a link between Dublin's drug trade and infamous gangster Martin Cahill in the mid-1990s. Starring Cate Blanchett, Gerard McSorley, Ciaran Hinds and Brenda Fricker.

programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: An orphan is forced to live a life of servitude by her cruel stepmother. The king of the realm she lives in organises a lavish ball to find a bride for his son, and a caring fairy godmother puts her magic to the task of turning the downtrodden girl into a princess. Animated fairytale, with the voices of Ilene Woods, William Phipps and Verna Felton.

programme.title: Cars 2
programme.desc: Racing car Lightning McQueen heads overseas to compete in an international grand prix, with events in Britain, Japan and Italy. He gets mixed up in international espionage when a case of mistaken identity leads to an encounter with two English spy cars searching for a powerful gadget. Pixar animated adventure sequel, with the voices of Owen Wilson and Michael Caine.

programme.title: Ralph Breaks the Internet
programme.desc: Six years after the events of Wreck-It Ralph, the destructive video game character and his hyperactive friend Vanellope discover a wi-fi router in Litwak's Family Fun Centre and Arcade. Before long, they embark on a new quest involving Disney princesses, and a few familar faces. Animated adventure, with the voices of John C Reilly, Sarah Silverman and Gal Gadot.

programme.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Dog Days
programme.desc: Weedy youngster Greg finds his plans for a lazy school holiday ruined when his mother bans video games and his father organises a series of family activities. When he finds out a girl he likes is working at a country club, he tells his family he has a summer job there as an excuse to spend time with her - but struggles to keep up the deception. Family comedy sequel, starring Zachary Gordon and Steve Zahn.

programme.title: The Princess and the Frog
programme.desc: A hard-working New Orleans waitress meets an arrogant prince who has been turned into a frog by a magic spell. When she tries to break the enchantment by kissing him, she also ends up transformed into an amphibian, and together they go in search of the voodoo queen who can change them back. Disney animated musical fantasy, with the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A prince is transformed into a hideous monster as punishment for his selfishness, and can only regain his human form by finding true love. Salvation comes in the form of a spirited village girl, who offers to take her father's place when he is imprisoned in the monster's castle. But as romance blossoms between the unlikely pair, a jealous rival suitor only sees a beast to be slain. Live-action remake of the Disney animated fairy tale, starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans, with Ewan McGregor, Emma Thompson and Ian McKellen playing the Beast's entourage of living ornaments.

programme.title: The Parent Trap
programme.desc: Identical twin sisters who are unaware of each other's existence meet by accident. They decide to join forces in a bid to reunite their estranged parents, and switch places to get the warring couple to kiss and make up. Remake of the 1961 Disney comedy, starring Dennis Quaid, Natasha Richardson, Elaine Hendrix and Lindsay Lohan in a dual role.

programme.title: The Jungle Book
programme.desc: A boy is raised by animals in the jungles of India, but his carefree life is threatened by the return of a fierce tiger with a grudge against humans. The youngster faces a difficult choice between remaining with his friends or returning to his own people. Live action remake of Disney's animated adventure based on Rudyard Kipling's stories, starring Neel Sethi, with the voices of Bill Murray, Ben Kingsley and Idris Elba.

programme.title: Cool Runnings
programme.desc: A sprinter fails to qualify for the Jamaican Olympic squad, but refuses to give up his dream. Learning that a former US bobsleigh coach is living nearby, he seizes the chance to shine in an entirely different sport, and cajoles three of his friends to join him in training for the 1988 Winter Olympics in the far less tropical environment of Canada. Fact-based comedy, with John Candy, Leon, Doug E Doug and Malik Yoba.

programme.title: I Love You, Beth Cooper
programme.desc: A teenager uses a graduation speech to publicly reveal a few secrets - including proclaiming his love for a pretty classmate. To his surprise, she is flattered by the gesture, but her ex-boyfriend is furious and they are soon forced to spend a night fleeing for their lives together. Comedy, starring Paul Rust and Hayden Panettiere.

programme.title: The Amateur
programme.desc: When his supervisors at the CIA refuse to take action after his wife is killed in a London terrorist attack, a cryptographer takes matters into his own hands. Thriller, starring Rami Malek, Laurence Fishburne, Rachel Brosnahan and Jon Bernthal.

programme.title: Let's Be Cops
programme.desc: Two friends go to a fancy-dress party as police officers, and are amazed by how people on the street react to their uniforms. They decide to pose as cops in the hope of enjoying the perks of the job, but soon end up in over their heads with gangsters and corrupt members of the real force. Comedy, starring Jake Johnson and Damon Wayans Jr.

programme.title: Gifted
programme.desc: Single man Frank Adler attempts to raise his child prodigy niece, Mary. However, his plans for a normal school life for the youngster are foiled when the youngster's mathematical abilities come to the attention of Frank's formidable mother, Evelyn. Drama, starring Chris Evans, Lindsay Duncan and Mckenna Grace.

programme.desc: Aspiring fashion journalist Rebecca Bloomwood accepts a position writing for a financial magazine. As she sets the publishing world alight with her unique brand of consumer advice, Rebecca is forced to confront her own purchasing habits and begins to question whether rampant spending sprees are the way to true happiness. Comedy, starring Isla Fisher, Hugh Dancy, Krysten Ritter and Joan Cusack.

programme.title: Jamie's 15 Minute Meals
programme.desc: Beef Kofta Curry And Spring Frittata. Jamie cooks an easy beef kofta curry, fluffy rice, beans and peas. Plus, spring frittata, tomato toasts, watercress and pea salad. S1, Ep32

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Home: Dinner Start To Finish. Ree makes dinner in real time, starting at the end with dessert. And, she makes steak Diane, easy roasted parmesan potatoes and garlic butter mushrooms. S27, Ep12

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Home: Take-Along. Ree shares delicious eats to take to parties and cookouts. Dishes include a grilled potato salad, queso with grilled veggies and quick and easy fruit tarts. S27, Ep13

programme.title: James Martin's Mediterranean
programme.desc: James is in the port of Pisciotta, where he learns why Italian gelato is the best in the world and goes anchovy fishing. Plus, he serves up barbequed figs with goat's cheese. S1, Ep2

programme.title: James Martin's Mediterranean
programme.desc: James is in Cap d'Agde on France's coast, where he tries its world-class oysters straight from the sea and heads to Montpelier's central market in search of duck confit. S1, Ep3

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Britain's best amateur bakers compete in the iconic white tent! Who will struggle under pressure and who will impress judges, Paul Hollywood and Prue Leith? S12, Ep2

programme.title: Mary Berry's Quick Cooking
programme.desc: The Navy. Mary boards one of the Royal Navy's mightiest warships, the HMS Defender. As the crew take part in a war training exercise, Mary helps out the hard-working kitchen team. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Michel Roux's French Country Cooking
programme.desc: It's seafood delivery day and Michel splashes out on all sorts of delicious ingredients to make a seafood platter. Plus, he harvests asparagus at his local organic farm. S2, Ep5

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Cooking For Less
programme.desc: With the rising cost of food and energy, Jamie Oliver is on a mission to make delicious dishes that won't break the budget. S1, Ep2

programme.title: New: Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation

programme.title: New: Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation
programme.desc: Triple D Nation: World Recipes. Guy Fieri's going global with mighty momos in Ohio, prime-time pork pho in Chicago, and big-deal veal saltimbocca in Los Angeles. S8, Ep4

programme.title: New: Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation
programme.desc: Guy Fieri's heading back for boiled crawfish in New Orleans, smoked spam loco moco in California, and a prime-time pork schnitzel sandwich in Chicago. S8, Ep5

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and two chefs, Tommy and Mini, have very similar ingredients - both are cooking mackerel. But Mini is trying an original beetroot sorbet while Tommy is using wild woodruff and oyster leaf from his own garden. Chris Archer has chosen the king of the sea, turbot, but there is controversy in the kitchen.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course of the north east region and overnight there has been a dramatic development. It is a tough and emotional day for the chefs as they react to the news but they battle on in a bid to present a perfect dish with venison and wagyu-angus beef - the meat of the day.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is a highly emotional day for one of the chefs as he prepares a dish which is inspired by and a tribute to his own great Briton, his late grandfather. But all is not going to plan and the chef ends up making one key element three times in a bid to achieve perfection.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton for the very first time. Joining them as guest judge is John Williams MBE, the executive head chef at The Ritz, the only hotel to hold a royal warrant for banqueting.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is Chris McGowan's third time however, he is facing tough competition from Mark Abbott, head chef at Daniel Clifford's 2 Michelin star restaurant, Midsummer House, and also from Eddie Attwell who has just completed a year as head chef at Ardtara Country House in Upperlands.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Mark Abbott is pushing himself again plating up a complex fish course of the very finest produce. He is calling it Shellsational but at the last minute he forgets a key element. Returning chef Chris McGowan is refining cod and chips and Eddie Attwell is getting classical with the king of the sea, turbot.The repartee is relentless as the chefs jostle for top place on the leader board. Once again there is plenty of emotion as the veteran chef delivers the scores.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course and returning Chef Chris McGowan is feeling confident but part of his dish involves making his own venison sausages to serve with a venison rack, and getting it all done in time is straining his emotions. Eddie Attwell is also serving the meat but with a traditional Northern Irish dish called Dock pudding. Mark Abbott is pushing himself again, he is using wagyu beef and serving it with tongue and corn cooked in a variety of ways.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The three chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking their desserts and one chef is on course for a historic score, he could beat his boss - a veteran of GBM - and achieve more marks than anyone has done throughout the history of the competition.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, restaurant critic and Editor-at-Large of the Independent, Amol Rajan.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the national finals of `Great British Menu'. Before cooking starts the eight champions are called to London's Southbank to get a sight of the prize, the chance to cook at a banquet held at the Palace of Westminster, in celebration of everyday Great Britons honoured by the Queen. It has a huge impact on every one of the chefs, each is determined to do all he can to get a dish to the banquet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's day two of the national finals, and the eight champions cook their fish courses. This year's challenge has been to produce dishes that are a lasting legacy to the New Elizabethan Age. They must showcase the transformation in British cuisine during the Queen's historic 64 year reign.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is main course day, the one course every chef wants to cook at the banquet. Judging the chefs' dishes are Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton and guest judge John Williams MBE, executive chef of The Ritz.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the final day of the competition, and the last chance for the eight champions to get one of their dishes to the banquet for Queen Elizabeth ll's Great Britons. Judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton will judge the dessert course and then decide on the banquet menu to be served at the Houses of Parliament. Joining them in the judging chamber is Grace Dent, restaurant critic, journalist and author.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The winning chefs arrive at the Palace of Westminster to cook for the Banquet of Great Britons. The chefs have been selected because their dishes showcase contemporary British cuisine and demonstrate the transformation in British food during the Queen's historic reign.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Competing for top spot are Danny Parker, head chef at Michelin starred `House of Tides' in Newcastle, who is back to try his luck in the competition again after being knocked out in the regional heat last year following a tense tie-break. He's taking on two newcomers: Dan Fletcher, protégé of Phil Howard, and now head chef at `Fenchurch' in the City of London, and David Coulson,who runs `Peace and Loaf' in Newcastle, which boasts 2 AA rosettes.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: After a tense starter course the chefs are all aiming for 10s with their unique fish dishes. David is celebrating a personal connection to the brief with his `My Cod I Bet Me Ma'am Has Seen Some Trotters', a tribute to his mum who has worked as a chiropodist. Dan's `For All Those Sleepless Nights' pays tribute to nightshift workers from the NHS with some bold but classic flavours while Danny's `Not All Superheroes Wear Capes' aims to give a taste of luxury to the hardworking staff.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Dan pays tribute to an icon of modern nursing, Florence Nightingale, while Danny in inspired by the founder of the NHS, Aneurin Bevan. David's dish is dedicated to the air ambulance staff who saved the life of his fiancé, and he even takes a trip to meet one of them.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the chefs' last chance to impress and tensions are high. Dan takes a risk with an unusual combination of ewe's milk and bergamot while Danny is determined to pull out all the stops with his complex dessert `Aunty Gwen's Chocolate'. David hopes to transform a childhood comfort classic into a show stopping dessert. Dan also takes a trip to meet Dr Ben Clarke who was working in the Royal London Hospital A&E during the London Bridge terror attack.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining North East chefs must cook their four course menus again, but will they take on board their veteran's advice as they serve their `Feast To Say Thank You'?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Banquet champion Selin Kiazim, a rising star of the London scene renowned for her Turkish Cypriot fusion flavours, is back hoping to join the elite group of chefs who have made it to the banquet twice. She is up against James Cochran who's worked at some of London's toughest kitchens including 2 Michelin starred `The Ledbury' and Scott Goss from `The Twenty Six' in Tunbridge Wells, renowned for his use of local Kent ingredients.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs do battle for the fish course and the atmosphere in the kitchen is tense. Lobster is catch of the day for James whose dish is Caribbean-inspired. Scott is attempting to elevate a classic fish pie, dedicated to his mum who worked as a pharmacist in the NHS for 23 years. And Selin is taking a risk with a complex three-part fish dish featuring sardines, scallops and langoustines, as a nod to the purported health benefits of a Mediterranean diet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Scott is showcasing rare breed Tamworth pork to say thank you to the rare breed of people who work for the NHS. Selin is serving a complex duck dish using ingredients from all around the world to honour `Our Global NHS'. And James is presenting five cuts of goat cooked in five different ways, for his bold dish `Under The Knife'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Selin puts her own unique twist on tea and toast. James creates a decadent coconut parfait accompanied by mango puree filled doughnuts for his dessert `Tree of Life' inspired by the coconut palm tree, the NHS and both of their contributions to our health. Scott hopes his elevated gypsy tart `Honey Bee Good' will secure him a place in the final.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining London and the South East chefs must cook their four-course menus again, but will they take on board their veteran's advice as they re-make their `Feast To Say Thank You'?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Vying to be crowned champion of Scotland are three talented newcomers to the GBM kitchen. Lorna McNee is a former Scottish Chef of the Year and is renowned for her technical precision which she has gained from working her entire career at 2 Michelin-starred restaurant Andrew Fairlie at Gleneagles.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the fish course and the chefs are all out to impress. The heat is increased as all three serve their unique takes on lobster. Ross is hoping to snatch victory with his dish `Lobster Aid'. Lorna's `Live Well, Live Very Well' features only three elements, each of which she needs to deliver perfection.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Ross is hoping to impress with `Oh Deer It's Time For Your Penicillin', his tribute to Scottish scientist Alexander Fleming featuring an unusual yeast element as well as venison. Across the kitchen, Lorna, a former Game Chef of the Year, is also cooking venison in a bid to impress.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's dessert day and the last chance for the chefs to impress before one is sent home. Ross is attempting to elevate a comfort classic into a dish worthy of the banquet. Lorna's cooking a personal tribute to the NHS staff who have cared for her during treatment for a rare blood condition, using unusual yuzu and tonka bean flavours. Once again Ben is serving an experimental dish with his `Dance for the Greater Good' which includes a bees wax ice cream.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's judging day and the two remaining chefs must impress the panel of Oliver Peyton, Andi Oliver and Matthew Fort. Both chefs are gunning for success and are doing everything they can to deliver their menus to perfection.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three chefs compete in the heat for the central region. Returner Ryan Simson-Trotman, who failed to reach the national finals last year, is originally from Nuneaton and opened his own restaurant Orwells in the Oxfordshire countryside with his partner Liam, who is also a contestant in the North West region.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the fish course and the chefs are pulling out all the stops. Marianne pays tribute to the `angels' in her local hospital who looked after her during a recent illness. Ryan's dish is a reference to the purported health benefits of fish high in omega 3 oils. While Sabrina is inspired by her aunt, a retired nurse who used to take in food to share with her fellow workers during her shifts.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs cook their mains and following yesterday's results, tension is high. Both Marianne and Ryan are cooking muntjac in the hope of impressing the veteran judge, while Sabrina is making an ambitious technical take on a family feast.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: With one dish left to impress the veteran judge, the chefs cook their desserts. Marianne is looking to raise a smile with her `carry on' themed dessert, complete with surprise presentation. Sabrina hopes to make it through with an elevated take on jelly and ice cream while Ryan goes all out with his very sweet treat `A Spoonful of Sugar'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining central region chefs do battle for a place in the national finals. They must impress the formidable panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton with their four course menus.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Andrew is attempting to pay tribute to NHS staff with his innovative take on a traditional healing recipe, `Mum's Flu Fighting Chicken Soup'. Jason's `A Tea From The Heart' is a play on a post-war remedy which harks back to the era when the NHS was formed. And Chris is hoping to impress with his dish inspired by a therapeutic hospital garden featuring foraged herbs from the Welsh valley where he lives including wild chervil, pickled pine buds and yarrow tips.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: After the starter results, the chefs return to the kitchen hoping for high scores with their fish dishes. Chris once again is using ingredients he has foraged from around his restaurant, while Jason hopes to impress with a spicy scallop dish and Andrew prepares a cod dish with 11 different elements.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs are pulling out all the stops in a bid for big scores with their mains. All three dishes pay tribute to the founder of the NHS Aneurin Bevan, Chris's `Everything But The Squeal' is an ambitious pork sharing platter, while Jason's `For The Rich And The Poor' showcases lamb, and Andrew is hoping to impress with `Aneurin Bevan For Better Steak'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the dessert course and the last opportunity for the chefs to impress. Chris is hoping to triumph with another dish which showcases the foraged ingredients available around his restaurant, while Jason attempts a technical feat in his dessert inspired by a childhood hospital stay and Andrew is inspired by a dish by his great grandmother used to cook. Which two will make it through to the judging chamber?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the Wales regional final as the two remaining chefs do everything they can to impress the judging panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. After tensions ran high in the week, the chefs are under pressure to deliver perfection. The judges are joined by Aneira Thomas, the first baby born on the NHS, who is named in tribute to the service's founder Aneurin Bevan and who went on to dedicate her life to the service. Who will win a place in the national finals?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the Wales regional final as the two remaining chefs do everything they can to impress the judging panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. After tensions ran high in the week, the chefs are under pressure to deliver perfection. The judges are joined by Aneira Thomas, the first baby born on the NHS, who is named in tribute to the service's founder Aneurin Bevan and who went on to dedicate her life to the service. Who will win a place in the national finals?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the turn of three chefs representing the South West, including two who have competed before but meet in the kitchen this week for the very first time.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the fish course and with Tom renowned as a fish specialist all eyes are on him. He's cooking his take on a classic British fish supper in tribute to a charity which looks after the health of local fishermen. Jude is attempting a complex fusion dish featuring four different fish and an unusual X Ray themed presentation, while Olivia is paying tribute to the staff who looked after her during the birth of her first son with her take on curried monkfish.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the main course and two of the chefs are hoping duck will win the day. Tom is preparing a technically challenging duck dish steeped in NHS history while Jude is making a multi-element Chinese duck dish inspired by his mum. Olivia is hoping her dish, using two unusual cuts of beef, will score top points. Olivia also visits her local children's hospital, home of the second busiest paediatric A&E in the country.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: With just one more chance to impress their veteran judge, the chefs are all hoping to use their pastry skills to deliver technically complex desserts. Tom's cooking an `Invalid Fruit Tart' inspired by a 1950s recipe, while Jude is making six different apple elements for his `An Apple A Day'. Olivia is using stout in reference to an outdated old wives' tale which suggested the drink was a healthy source of iron during pregnancy.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's time for the two remaining chefs representing the South West to go head to head as they cook their menus again for the exacting panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. With a spot in the National Finals at stake, both are aiming for perfection as they bid for glory. The judges are joined by Barbara Childs, a Matron in the Cardiac Intensive Care Unit at Great Ormond Street Hospital, who isn't afraid to speak her mind in the chamber.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three chefs take to the kitchen in a bid to represent the North West in the national final. They include Ellis Barrie, from the award winning Marram Grass in Anglesey, Liam Simpson-Trotman, an accomplished pastry chef and co-owner of the 4 AA rosette Orwell's in Oxfordshire, and Craig Sherrington, who sharpened his skills working under top names including Eric Chavot and is now Chef Patron of Virginia House in Cumbria.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the fish course and the chefs are all gunning for tens. Craig pays tribute to a friend who has revolutionised hospital food in Morecambe Bay, while Liam is inspired by health advice his grandma gave him and Ellis is dedicating his dish to the staff who delivered his son Albert. With cod, mackerel, shrimp and cockles on the menu, which of the chefs will score highly?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Time for the chefs to cook their mains and the pressure is on. Craig is hoping to impress using two cuts of Dexter beef, while Liam prepares his take on a Bajan lamb stew and Ellis prepares four cuts of suckling pig. Liam meets his personal hero, Nola Ishmael OBE, who became the UK's first ever black Director of Nursing.

programme.title: Ten Days to Victory

programme.title: America: The War Years
programme.desc: Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. Pre-Pearl Harbor, the US helped democracies and men joined the army to prepare for WW2 and Japan's threat.

programme.title: America: The War Years
programme.desc: Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. In 1942 the US had victories in the Doolittle Raid, Coral Sea and Midway while the Nazi's were taking Europe.

programme.title: America: The War Years
programme.desc: Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. Take a look at WW2 in 1943, where the battle turned against North Africa and plans were laid to bomb Germany.

programme.title: America: The War Years
programme.desc: Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. In 1944, the US waged global war towards Rome and the Pacific, and 6 June marked the D-Day landings.

programme.title: America: The War Years
programme.desc: The Battle of the Bulge continued in 1945 and the US battled stiff resistance on Leyte and Iwo Jima.

programme.title: The Mistake that Killed Hitler
programme.desc: In April 1945, as Stalin's Red Army approach from the east and the western Allied forces quickly approach through France and Belgium, Adolf Hitler awaits his fate in his bunker, reflecting on the mistakes that lost him the war.

programme.title: The Great Nazi Escape
programme.desc: Europe became a dangerous place to be associated with the Nazi regime as thousands of Nazi officers, party members and supporters of Hitler began to flee Germany.

programme.title: Churchill: The Road to Victory
programme.desc: Winston Churchill served as the Prime Minister of Great Britain in arguably some of the most trying times of modern history. After Chamberlain's resignation in 1940, Churchill was appointed during World War II and ultimately led the country down the road to victory.

programme.title: Hitler's Lost Battles
programme.desc: A look at the strategic decisions made by Hitler during the Battle of Britain, which led to Operation Barbarossa, and the Axis invasion of the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Hitler's Lost Battles
programme.desc: The poor military decisions made by Hitler started to become clear by 1942. America got involved in the conflict as a reaction to his declaration of war, as they made ground in North Africa.

programme.title: D-Day: Secrets of the Solent
programme.desc: D-Day saw 453 air sorties from the Solent to support the massive Normandy assault.

programme.title: Battles Won & Lost
programme.desc: A look at how mechanised warfare aided Germany's advance into France; a look at the way commando raids, blitzkrieg, mobile desert warfare, and amphibious landings changed warfare.

programme.title: Battles Won & Lost
programme.desc: The battles of World War II increase in sheer size of the forces involved as well as the power of their weapons; a look inside Germany's strategies for Operation Barbarossa, as they attempt to invade the Soviet Union.

programme.desc: In 1964, ITV broadcast a film about 14 seven-year-olds, which became the longest-running documentary series ever. This programme looks at the year 7 Up was made, the idea behind it, and what the subjects hoped for in a Britain about to change around them.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress

programme.title: Death by Gossip
programme.desc: When young mother Lillian Jarvis is killed by a mail bomb, gossip explodes in the community as secrets about her past come to light.

programme.title: Death by Gossip
programme.desc: A Silicon Valley executive goes missing, then turns up stuffed in a sleeping bag at the bottom of the San Francisco Bay.

programme.title: Conviction: Murder at the Station
programme.desc: Following a team of experts as they investigate whether evidence exists that could challenge the conviction of a man in prison for a murder he denies. Every year, over 500 people in the UK are convicted of murder. A guilty verdict can only be challenged if new evidence comes to light. Inside Justice is a specialist charity led by Louise Shorter, supported by a panel of criminal lawyers, ex-police officers and forensics experts who offer assistance to prisoners who are protesting their innocence.

programme.title: Conviction: Murder at the Station
programme.desc: Louise investigates a case, looking for evidence that could present grounds to bring an appeal, and ultimately overturn the conviction of a Southampton man in prison for the murder of his secret lover.

programme.title: Conviction: Murder in Suburbia
programme.desc: Inside Justice investigate the conviction of Glyn Razzell, found guilty of his wife's murder. Glyn maintains his innocence, and now there's an alleged link with a double murderer.

programme.title: Killed Walking Home
programme.desc: Every three days, a woman is killed in the UK. These women could be sisters, daughters and friends. Although there is a lead that breaks open the case, what comes in light of the investigation is one that leaves an everlasting scar on the families.

programme.title: The Manson Murders
programme.desc: The Manson Family, led by Charles Manson, committed a set of crimes that terrified the world and brought the flower power movement to a halt. Charles Milles Manson was an American criminal and musician who led the Manson Family, a cult based in California.

programme.title: Mafia's Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Gambino family soldier Roy DeMeo and his crew were suspected of killing dozens of people and dismembering their bodies, but the FBI and other mobsters were soon on his trail.

programme.title: Mafia's Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Meyer Lansky was an associate of `Lucky' Luciano and linked to criminal financial operations, but the FBI struggled to pin anything on him - or find his riches.

programme.title: Mafia's Greatest Hits
programme.desc: The final episode of this gripping series reveals what happened when the FBI pursued the five clans who ran organised crime in New York, as well as the fate of two brave informers.

programme.title: Murderous Minds: Peter Tobin
programme.desc: Peter Britton Tobin was a Scottish convicted serial killer and sex offender who served a whole life order at HM Prison Edinburgh for three murders committed between 1991 and 2006. Delve into the psychology of Peter to try and understand what turned him into such a cruel rapist and murderer.

programme.title: Fred & Rose West: Love & Murder
programme.desc: Fred and Rose West raped, tortured and murdered at least a dozen young British girls between 1967 and 1987, including several of their own daughters. Learn how two of Britain's most notorious serial killers were able to get away with their crimes for so long, how they hid the victim's remains within the confines of their own home, and how they were eventually taken down.

programme.title: When Fred Met Rose
programme.desc: Documentary series examining what led Fred and Rose West to become serial killers.

programme.desc: Arjun Amitabh and Pyare Govinda are cops. Trouble follows when thieves Bade Miyan and Chote Miyan, lookalikes of Arjun and Pyare, commit crimes and pin them on the hapless duo.

programme.title: Extraaa Storiez: Bhool Bhulaiyaa 2
programme.desc: Watch behind the scenes and meet the cast and crew of the movie.

programme.title: Comedy Station - Bittu Bak Bak
programme.desc: Series of short, comedic vignettes where an unlucky Bhojpuri producer Champaklal and his secretary Suzie hilariously navigate chaotic, low-budget filmmaking.

programme.title: Malaal
programme.desc: Class divides become thorns in the budding romance between the crony of a nativist Mumbai politician and the new, North Indian resident of his chawl.

programme.title: Starfish
programme.desc: While working at a dredging company, a diver seeks out the truth behind a tragic loss, but an unexpected romance could help or hinder her search.

programme.title: Na Tum Jaano Na Hum
programme.desc: A romantically inclined couple decide to get to know each other through letters without disclosing their identities.

programme.title: Afwaah
programme.desc: A woman seeks to escape her engagement to a violent politician, but when a stranger comes to her aid, the two face an onslaught of bigotry and hate.

programme.title: Adipurush
programme.desc: While serving a long exile, a righteous warrior prince sets out on an epic journey across land and sea to rescue his wife from a demon king.

programme.title: Har Dil Jo Pyar Karega
programme.desc: Raj is a singer trying to make his way in Mumbai. One night, he rescues a girl who has fallen in front of a train and his life changes forever.

programme.title: Panipat
programme.desc: In 18th-century India, a Maratha commander leads his army in preparation for a fierce battle against Afghan invaders in this film based on real events.

programme.title: Mardaani 3
programme.desc: Fearless cop Shivani Shivaji Roy returns to hunt down a ruthless criminal network responsible for kidnapping more than 90 girls across the country.

programme.title: A.aa 2
programme.desc: Two people fall in love but get separated until they realise destiny has other plans for them.

programme.title: Haseen Dillruba
programme.desc: Under investigation as a suspect in her husband's murder, a woman reveals details of their thorny marriage that seem to only further blur the truth.

programme.title: Nazar Andaaz
programme.desc: A carefree blind man living with his loyal caretaker inadvertently launches a chaotic competition for his wealth when he befriends a small-time thief.

programme.title: Mazzaq
programme.desc: Pretending as mentally challenged and unemployed, Vinod earns his bread in Bombay. Soon he finds a job in Bangalore and falls for the CEO's daughter. Crisis strikes when her dad learns about his past.

programme.title: Pyar Mein Twist
programme.desc: With their respective children's' marriages about to take place, two middle-aged single parents fall in love.

programme.title: Maa Kasam
programme.desc: Ajay Shastri has been appointed the new inspector in a small town. However, his loyalty towards his profession does not go well with Acharya, the local gangster, who decides to finish him off

programme.title: Meri Biwi Ki Shaadi
programme.desc: Professor Bhagawant is happily married to Priya. When he finds out he has a terminal illness he decides to look for a second husband for his wife, this leads to various comic events.

programme.title: Raaste Pyar Ke
programme.desc: Mohan falls in love with Gouri. Later, Gouri learns that her friend Shyama also loves Mohan and decides to sacrifice her love for Shyama.

programme.title: Eeshwar
programme.desc: Ishwar is a simple-minded and honest young man, devout and religious, he cares for everybody. He meets with a young widow with a son and marries her. This story is about him and his triumphs.

programme.title: Be-shaque
programme.desc: Prakash comes to a village in a bid to find his friend Shyam, who has gone missing. He is further baffled on seeing a picture of his girlfriend with a man and a child and decides to investigate.

programme.title: Chowkidaar
programme.desc: Shyam, son of a money lender, Dinanath, falls in love with a watchman's daughter, Radha. When Shyam decides to marry her, Dinanath hatches evil plans to prevent their wedding.

programme.title: Aa Gale Lag Jaa
programme.desc: Preeti, a wealthy woman, is in an intimate relationship with Prem but her father disapproves and orchestrates their breakup. Years later, Preeti is reunited with Prem under different circumstances.

programme.title: Gautam Govinda
programme.desc: A police officer is assigned to a village over-run by criminals. He bumps into his long lost brother who is the personal hit-man of the arrogant and aristocratic goon. Will faith bring them together?

programme.title: Conversation With Rajkummar Rao 2
programme.desc: Rajkummar Rao, one of the most talented and versatile actors today, talks about his being an outsider to the industry, the different shades of unique characters he plays and his success. (1/2)

programme.title: Mujhe Kasam Hai
programme.desc: Inspector Rakesh, in love with Rita, daughter of reformed dacoit turned politician Mangal Singh, discovers Mangal's thugs caused his sister's death. Rakesh now seeks revenge.

programme.title: Rafta Rafta The Speed
programme.desc: "Rafta Rafta: The Speed" follows a young man's journey into the thrilling world of illegal street racing, facing dangerous rivals and high stakes as he chases victory and recognition.

programme.title: Naya Raasta
programme.desc: Chander, a criminal lawyer, gives up his successful career and returns to his ancestral village. There, he comes face-to-face with social problems such as casteism, untouchability and poverty.

programme.title: Justice Choudhary
programme.desc: Justice Chowdhary gives up his moral values and determines to seek revenge after his entire family is abducted and killed in his presence.

programme.title: Conversation With Javed Akhtar 2
programme.desc: Lyricist, poet, screenwriter, Javed Akhtar along with film expert Nasreen Ali and Shabana Azmi, provides a fascinating and personal insight into his extraordinary life and new book Talking Life. (2/5)

programme.title: Phir Milenge

programme.title: Ghar Ka Chirag
programme.desc: A wealthy widower marries the daughter of a school principal when her lover is assumed dead. Five years later, her lover returns and sets out to find the truth behind her marriage.

programme.title: Dil Tujhko Diya
programme.desc: Two step brothers are separated after their father dies and they mother goes to jail. Years later they come together but the elder brother detests the younger and hates the mother for killing his dad.

programme.title: Ijaazat
programme.desc: An estranged couple accidentally meet in a railway station's waiting room and revisit their past.

programme.title: Jeevan Ek Sanghursh

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
programme.desc: E3The German mass breakout that stunned wartime Britain, the astonishing secret behind the daring escape of an American bomber crew trapped in the Soviet Union, and the Trojan Horse of Stalag Luft Three.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
programme.desc: E4The Russian soldier who led a desperate outbreak from a secret Nazi death camp, Operation Chicken - an audacious plan to flee an escape-proof Japanese prison camp, and the pilots whose bold bid for freedom won the admiration of their enemies.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The F15 Eagle immediately turned the tide of the first Gulf War to prove its greatness. Our immaculately restored MiG Killer was involved in one of the most bizarre combat incidents during that conflict, and has survived to tell the tale.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E6In 1961, Soviet T-54 tanks and American M-48 Patton tanks face off at Checkpoint Charlie in Berlin.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E1Viking combat ships changed the course of history. Their longships brought William the Conqueror’s troops to Hastings, adventurers to North America and raiders to plunder the Saxon kingdoms.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
programme.desc: E5The elite German submariners who caused havoc in the heart of the American desert, the playboy pilot they couldn’t cage, and the young lovers whose escape defied all odds.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
programme.desc: E6Hitler’s last soldier in America who defied the FBI for 40 years, the Auschwitz prisoners who releaved the secrets of the death camps, and the merciless Nazi who almost got away.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The Avro Lancaster is the legendary British heavy bomber that carved its place in history with Bomber Command during World War 2. That conflict saw over seven thousand of these iconic aircraft come off the production line.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2Unusually, we look at the later, clipped wing version flown by Czech refugee pilots in the UK during WW2. We get close-up with a beautifully restored example, fly her and unearth long unseen test and operational footage.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E9In 1989, 20,000 US troops entered Panama to overthrow military dictator Manuel Noriega and around 500 civilians were killed. What prompted the invasion?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E10How will the new Cold War, involving the US, Russia, the UK and China, play out? Will trade and cyber warfare be the worst of it or is military war inevitable?

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E8A look at the origins of the Arms Race between the USA and the Soviet Union, and the nuclear weapons that ended WWII.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E7A look at the military engineering used as US and South Vietnamese forces attempt to overcome North Vietnam and the Viet Cong.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The aircraft capable of delivering the payload of a B17, in a single post war air frame. The many variants of this single piston engined fighter bomber helped dominate the air to ground attack role in Vietnam, earning quite a reputation.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6The definitive combat helicopter saw first blood in South East Asia and has been transport, gunship, smoke ship, command centre, MediVac and dozens of other roles. We hear and see it's hair raising missions and watch it earn its fame.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E5A Greenpeace ship is bombed in 1985, killing Fernando Pereira. The French authorities deny responsibility and questions over nuclear restrictions arise again.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E6In 1979, Maurice Bishop takes control of Grenada. Four years later, he is assassinated. Is this another case of the US using its might to stop Communism?

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E1Two iconic machines of World War II - the Spitfire symbolised British hope and resistance, while the Tiger tank embodied German power.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E2The Vietnam war changed aerial warfare in more ways than one. The Phantom became the first true fighter bomber of the modern era.

programme.title: The Last Hunt For Nazi Gold
programme.desc: E3At the Altaussee salt mine, Guy Walters and Justine discover replicas of looted masterpieces and reflect on miners’ efforts to save priceless works from Nazi destruction. At Hans’s mountain home, they study diagrams of vanished art.

programme.title: The Last Hunt For Nazi Gold
programme.desc: E4Guy Walters and Justine follow one of the most famous legends of WWII: the Wałbrzych Gold Train. Their search through Poland blends tense encounters, eccentric characters, and moments of farce as they try to separate fact from fantasy.

programme.title: The Last Hunt For Nazi Gold
programme.desc: E5Guy Walters and Justine across Italy in pursuit of Nazi gold. With historian Madeline, they uncover the story of Italy’s betrayal and looted treasure, before exploring the fortress of Fortezza and its underground caverns.

programme.title: The Last Hunt For Nazi Gold
programme.desc: E6At the Fischerhütte restaurant, owner Albrecht Syen shares tales of past discoveries. On the lake itself, torrential rain and a comical attempt to use a GoPro as an underwater drone highlight the chaotic reality of treasure hunting.

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: E5During the early months and years of the war, Britain and her allies were almost powerless to hit back at Germany. They were on the back foot, unable to take the war to where the Germans would feel it most – Germany.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
programme.desc: E5The elite German submariners who caused havoc in the heart of the American desert, the playboy pilot they couldn’t cage, and the young lovers whose escape defied all odds.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
programme.desc: E5The elite German submariners who caused havoc in the heart of the American desert, the playboy pilot they couldn’t cage, and the young lovers whose escape defied all odds.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
programme.desc: E6Hitler’s last soldier in America who defied the FBI for 40 years, the Auschwitz prisoners who releaved the secrets of the death camps, and the merciless Nazi who almost got away.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2The mighty Flying Fortress takes to the air as we examine the background and development of one of WWIIs most iconic bombers. Serving with both the USAAF and the RAF, we see it in action and fly a surfing example.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E8A look at the origins of the Arms Race between the USA and the Soviet Union, and the nuclear weapons that ended WWII.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E2In Stealth we examine the methods ships have used to evade detection. With the advent of radar in WW2, ships that wanted to remain undetected had to find ways to hide.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E1In the north of Crete, six commandos land in a cove. On this island that has been occupied for two years, they have been given a high-risk mission—to infiltrate the Heraklion airfield to destroy the Luftwaffe bombers and fighter planes.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E2December 7th, 1942. Off the coast of France, ten British commandos board five canoes in the middle of the ocean. Their objective: to paddle to the Gironde estuary, then up the river to Bordeaux to sabotage German ships.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The definitive, if not the best, Axis fighter of World War two: we delve into the story of legendary ace Adolf Galland and examine in detail and example of the type in his colours. We also look at the technical heritage the 109 designers left.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4The story of the prolonged development and the initially troubled operational history of the Boeing B-29 Superfortress. Forever known as the airframe that dropped the first atomic weapons on Japan, the B-29 lived on well beyond its war years.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E1In the waters of Scapa Flow, discover sunken dreadnoughts that tell the story of how a U-Boat sank HMS Royal Oak. Later, on HMS Cavalier, we explore how a raid by commandos called Operation Chariot proved the vulnerability of the battleship.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E2The episode begins with the story of HMS Conqueror sinking the General Belgrano during the Falklands War. Later, a crew member from the USS Nautilus describes what it was like to serve on the world's first nuclear submarine.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E2The Vietnam war changed aerial warfare in more ways than one. The Phantom became the first true fighter bomber of the modern era.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E1Two iconic machines of World War II - the Spitfire symbolised British hope and resistance, while the Tiger tank embodied German power.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The Grumman Avenger, which was the most important carrier-based torpedo bomber on American and British carriers throughout the Second World War. They were also the biggest and heaviest carrier aircraft of the conflict.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2The Junkers Ju 52, which is considered one of the most famous airplanes in history. It was first designed as an airliner, but was used as a transport, bomber, and air ambulance during the Second World War.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E7From 1969 to 1973, US forces bomb Cambodia and the country falls into a brutal form of communism. Did the US' involvement pave the way for Pol Pot's regime?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E8After the Cuban revolution, Fidel Castro looked to exert his influence in Venezuela. Is Cuba still in charge of Venezuela's future?

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E3A chronological telling of the dramatic D-Day story, focusing on vessels that made the landings possible. From the X-Craft lying on the seabed days before the invasion to battleships like USS Texas and HMS Belfast that bombarded the Normandy beaches.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E4We pinpoint the moment the USA became a global superpower when we recreate how the USS Olympia won the Battle of Manila Bay, and we show how the revolutionary British HMS Dreadnought brought ship design into the 20th century.

programme.title: World War Weird
programme.desc: E1Near the Czech border, a secret German site, "The Giant," tests The Bell, powered by Serum 525, turning all who touch it into rotting living zombies.

programme.title: World War Weird
programme.desc: E21942 and Hitler has the totally barking idea of using educated dogs to do a soldier's job. The Nazi leader wants to create fearsome canines to help him win the Second World War.

programme.title: Hitler's Coup 1923
programme.desc: E1Hitler’s Coup is the story around Hitler's Beer Hall Putsch, marking the first big attempt at taking over the German Chancellery with many of his key loyal servants in place: Herman Goering, Rudolf Hess & Heinrich Himmler.

programme.title: Secret Sex Lives Of Tyrants
programme.desc: E5Uncover how Saddam Hussein ruled Iraq through fear and violence, leaving a brutal legacy carried on by his sons.

programme.title: Secret Sex Lives Of Tyrants
programme.desc: E1The Ugandan military dictator, whose brutal eight-year rule left hundreds of thousands dead, led an equally sadistic sexual life.

programme.title: Hitler's British Island
programme.desc: E1On the orders of Adolf Hitler, the Nazi invaders of Alderney, a tiny island in the English Channel, shipped in more than 5,000 slave labourers to build an astonishing series of fortifications designed to protect the island from attack.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E1In the north of Crete, six commandos land in a cove. On this island that has been occupied for two years, they have been given a high-risk mission—to infiltrate the Heraklion airfield to destroy the Luftwaffe bombers and fighter planes.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E2December 7th, 1942. Off the coast of France, ten British commandos board five canoes in the middle of the ocean. Their objective: to paddle to the Gironde estuary, then up the river to Bordeaux to sabotage German ships.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3Often called 'the forgotten bomber', the mighty North American twin delivered the first blow in the fight back against Japan, in one of the most daring and audacious raids of all time.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E2The Vietnam war changed aerial warfare in more ways than one. The Phantom became the first true fighter bomber of the modern era.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E3Explore the design flaws and human errors that condemned great ships to a tragic end. In 1628 the warship Vasa sank on her maiden voyage. Together with Vasa curator Fred Hocker, solve the mystery of why this great ship sank.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E3On September 15th, 1942, 12 commandos reached Northern Norway. Their mission: to sabotage a hydroelectric plant crucial to the German war industry. To avoid detection, they decided to cross a huge high-altitude glacier.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E4In the midst of the reconquest of Italy, the Allies came up against the Winter Line—an impregnable line of defence built on the crests of a mountain range. They decided to call in a very special commando unit, the First Special Service Force.
